what: Photo sections stacked in one cell switch to the next every 5s. The next section sits on top and covers the old one over 2.4s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) as a cut face opens from the right edge toward the left (clip-path inset left 100% → 0). The image inside settles into place from 3% to the right at 1.1x, with the same length and curve. The old section stays underneath until the new one is fully open, so there is no gap. The first section stands still at the start. The clock pauses when offscreen. Used in the white-bordered hero photo and the regional photo sheet.

options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Section to overlap — its first child (the image) sits at 3% and 1.1x
options.interval: Interval before moving to the next section (s), default 5
options.from: Opening side: right (default, from the right edge) · left · bottom · top
options.shift: Distance the image is offset before settling into place (css length), default 3%
options.zoom: Scale the image is enlarged to before settling, default 1.1

from.where: index.html .sn-fv__splide · .sn-slidetext__splide, product.html .sn-cat__splide (original Splide fade 2.4s + clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%) → 0, image imgSlidein translate(3%) scale(1.1) → 0, old slide left underneath with is-close, interval 5s · region photos 4s). The copy site is built with Splide like the original, and this part produces the same motion without Splide

note: The original sits on Splide (fade, speed 2400, easing cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1)), but the visible motion comes from a css clip-path transition of 2.4s outquint, and this part extracts only that transition
